note: Alert color recolored from cyan to amber. Cyan was visually too close to the direction-buy green; Kirk caught it in the chair. Amber is distinct from all other luminos colors (red, green, slate gray, purple) and reads universally as attention/warning. Lerps from soft amber stale to vivid amber fresh. Now the protocol sentence works without ambiguity: red or green for direction, purple for intensity, amber for alert.
